title: Missing values, absence and nonfinite measurements
outcome: Keep missingness and numerical failure distinct and report the denominator used by each aggregation policy.

exercises.title: Retain the denominator
exercises.answer: The result describes the observed measurements, not an assumed completed dataset.

exercises.title: Replace explicitly
exercises.task: Fill the missing value with zero.
exercises.answer: The replacement policy changes the quantity being summarized.

exercises.title: Reject numerical failure
exercises.task: Include NaN among otherwise observed values.
exercises.answer: Unknown data and undefined floating arithmetic need distinct handling.

exercises.title: Handle all-missing data
exercises.expected: The observed count is 0 and estimate is missing.
exercises.hint: Do not fabricate a mean from an empty observed set.
exercises.answer: The output preserves unavailable information while retaining the eligible count.

exercises.title: Distinguish absence
exercises.expected: The former returns 7; the latter retains nothing.
exercises.hint: The helpers target different sentinel meanings.
exercises.answer: An absent return and a missing measurement should not be conflated accidentally.

exercises.title: Assess a real policy
exercises.task: Choose deletion or imputation for a scientific dataset.
exercises.expected: State assumptions, affected population and uncertainty.
exercises.hint: Correct manipulation does not prove valid inference.
exercises.answer: The missingness mechanism and decision target determine which policy is defensible.
